evidence.detail: preaggregate_archetype_playability uses _archetype_count (all decks, all seasons) as denominator
_archetype_count SQL: SELECT d.archetype_id, COUNT(*) AS num_decks FROM deck — no season or legality filter
_season_archetype_card_count joins _legal_cards to exclude illegal-season appearances, but _archetype_card_count (used by all-time query) has no such filter

Brainstorm in Mono Blue Tempo: numerator counts only decks where Brainstorm was played (legal seasons), denominator counts ALL Mono Blue Tempo decks across ALL seasons — artificially depresses score for cards with gaps in legality

triage.fix_sketch: In preaggregate_archetype_playability (decksite/data/playability.py:420), replace the join on _archetype_card_count/_archetype_count/_card_count with a GROUP BY aggregate over _season_archetype_card_count JOIN _season_archetype_count ON matching season_id and archetype_id, JOIN _season_card_count and _season_count — using SUM() over each. This naturally limits the denominator to only seasons where the card was legal (because _season_archetype_card_count already filters via _legal_cards). No schema change needed — the output table definition is unchanged.
triage.notes: Related to issue #12322 (testing request for this exact logic). The _archetype_card_count and _archetype_count helper tables may become unused after this fix and could be cleaned up separately.
